name: Terra Balcanica Resources Corp.
summary: Terra Balcanica Resources Corp. specializes in identifying, evaluating, and securing mineral property assets. The company's exploration efforts are directed towards finding deposits of gold, silver, copper, lead, and zinc. Its principal holding is the Viogor-Zanik project, located in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina, which includes three licensed concessions totaling 216.819 square kilometers. The corporation was established in 2020 and operates from its head office in Vancouver, Canada.
